review: 702.112a-1: blocked variant omitted that the 2/2 Grizzly Bears and the 2/2 Topan Freeblade kill each other; expected now records both deaths.
702.112c-1: base expected said the second trigger 'resolves and does nothing'; per 603.4 its intervening-if fails on resolution so it is removed without effect; reworded.

scenarios.title: Renown puts a +1/+1 counter on an unrenowned creature that deals combat damage to a player

setup.notes: Topan Freeblade (2/2 vigilance, renown 1) is not renowned.

decisions: A attacks B with Topan Freeblade.
B declares no blockers (Grizzly Bears does not block).
Combat damage is dealt; when the renown trigger goes on the stack both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: unblocked_unrenowned
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18). The renown trigger fires and resolves: Topan Freeblade gets one +1/+1 counter, is 3/3 and is renowned.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares its Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Topan Freeblade instead of declaring no blockers.
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals its 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, not to a player; B's life stays 20 and the renown trigger does not fire. Grizzly Bears and Topan Freeblade each take lethal damage and both go to their owners' graveyards in the state-based check.

variants.label: already_renowned
variants.delta: Topan Freeblade is already renowned and carries one +1/+1 counter (3/3) from an earlier combat.
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals 3 combat damage to B (life 17). The renown trigger does not fire because the creature is renowned; it keeps exactly one +1/+1 counter and stays 3/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: The renowned designation is a flag on the permanent that the engine tracks (IsRenowned); the already_renowned variant needs it set in the puzzle state.

scenarios.title: A renowned permanent that leaves the battlefield and returns is no longer renowned

setup.notes: It is A's end step. Topan Freeblade (renown 1) is renowned and carries two +1/+1 counters, so it is a 4/4. A has an untapped Plains and Cloudshift in hand. Libraries are listed top first.

decisions: A casts Cloudshift targeting Topan Freeblade, tapping Plains; both players pass and Cloudshift resolves.
The turn ends. B's turn passes with no plays and no attacks.
On A's next turn A attacks B with Topan Freeblade.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt and any trigger resolves.

variants.label: flickered
variants.expected: Cloudshift exiles Topan Freeblade and returns it as a new object with no counters (2/2) and not renowned. When it attacks and deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18), the renown trigger fires; it gets one +1/+1 counter, is 3/3 and is renowned.

variants.label: not_flickered
variants.delta: A does not cast Cloudshift; Topan Freeblade stays on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade attacks as a 4/4 and deals 4 combat damage to B (life 16). The renown trigger does not fire because it is still renowned; it keeps its two +1/+1 counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Whether the returned permanent is treated as a new, unrenowned object depends on Forge clearing the renowned flag on a zone change.

scenarios.title: With two instances of renown each triggers, but only the first to resolve adds a counter

setup.notes: Aragorn gives attacking creatures first strike and renown 1, so an attacking Topan Freeblade (renown 1 of its own, not renowned) has two instances of renown. Aragorn stays home.

decisions: A attacks B with Topan Freeblade only.
B declares no blockers (Grizzly Bears does not block).
First-strike combat damage is dealt; both renown triggers go on the stack, both players pass, and they resolve one after the other.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals 2 first-strike combat damage to B (life 18). Two renown triggers fire. The first resolves: one +1/+1 counter, Topan Freeblade is renowned. The second is removed from the stack on resolution without effect because Topan Freeblade is already renowned. Topan Freeblade ends with exactly one +1/+1 counter (3/3).

variants.label: single_instance
variants.delta: Aragorn, Hornburg Hero is not on the battlefield, so Topan Freeblade has one instance of renown.
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18). One renown trigger fires and resolves: one +1/+1 counter, Topan Freeblade is 3/3 and renowned.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares its Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Topan Freeblade instead of declaring no blockers.
variants.expected: Topan Freeblade deals its first-strike damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies. No combat damage is dealt to a player, neither renown trigger fires, and Topan Freeblade has no counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Aragorn's own trigger (a renowned creature dealing combat damage) does not fire here because Topan Freeblade is not yet renowned when it deals damage.
